note: CaixaBank's Visa &Go is its revolving credit card: what's used is always repaid in monthly instalments, at 20.40% a year nominal (TIN; 22.42% TAE). Its maintenance fee of 36 euros a year isn't charged if the card is used at least once in the year, written as a waiver on any spending. CaixaBank's other credit cards are paid at the month's end, their rates applying only to purchases split into instalments.

sources.title: CaixaBank, Tarjeta Visa &Go
sources.said: Si utilizas tu tarjeta al menos una vez al año, no pagarás la comisión de mantenimiento de 36 €. ... TAE 22,42 % y TIN 20,40 %. ... La tarjeta Visa &Go es una tarjeta de crédito. Con esta tarjeta, el importe que uses se devuelve siempre con pago aplazado
